test: F-test for fixed effects (Chow / redundant fixed effects)
H0: all country intercepts are equal (pooled OLS is enough)

test: Overall F-test of the FE model
H1: at least one slope differs from zero

test: Breusch-Pagan LM test for random effects
H0: variance of country effects is zero (pooled OLS is enough)
H1: country effects exist (use RE or FE)

H0: random effects are consistent (country effects uncorrelated with X)
H1: country effects correlated with X (use fixed effects)

test: Modified Wald test (groupwise heteroskedasticity, FE residuals)
note: low power and size distortions when T is small

H0: no first-order serial correlation in the idiosyncratic errors
note: estimated rho(differenced) = -0.590; clustered by country, so unreliable when N is small
